name: Tavernes de la Valldigna (Spain)
description: Sapphire blue field with white wavy stripes along the lower part, charged at the centre with a yellow turreted tower bearing a red flag.
history: The official flag of Tavernes de la Valldigna is of proportions 2:3, on a sapphire blue field wavy pearl grey stripes, and at the centre a turreted tower or, masoned sable and pierced red, with a red flag on the central turret, the tower occupying two thirds of the height of the flag; it was approved by resolution of 22 June 2001 of the Conseller of Justice and Public Administrations and published in the DOGV. The arms had been modified by resolution of 6 August 1993.
